html.t-att-data-balance-url: ('/' + db_name + '/' + tournament.slug + '/auction/show/team/balance') if db_name and tournament and tournament.slug else ''
html.t-att-data-rp-url: ('/' + db_name + '/' + tournament.slug + '/auction/display_auction/remaining-players?theme=' + hud_theme) if db_name and tournament and tournament.slug else ''

t.t-value: tournament or (player.tournament_id if player else None)

body.t-att-data-player-drawer: 'manual' if tournament and tournament.player_appearance_algorithm == 'random' and tournament.player_drawer_mode == 'manual' else 'automatic'

t.t-value: (player.kabaddi_role_label() if player.tournament_type == 'kabaddi' else (player.dominant_position_id.name if player.tournament_type == 'football' and player.dominant_position_id else (player.badminton_card_labels()['category'] if player.tournament_type == 'badminton' else (player.role or ''))))

t.t-esc: (tournament or player.tournament_id).format_points(player.effective_base_price or 0) if (tournament or (player and player.tournament_id)) else '{:,}'.format(int(player.effective_base_price or 0))
